description:
PR A only — durable capture and authorized access, not runtime consumption. Create/resolve Direct/Shared/Replicated transcripts and persist per-message associations from trusted facts before response-trigger decisions. Retain nonmentions without response; preserve existing explicit triggers; prevent echoes/duplicate public answers. Enforce transcript-path authorization for People/BO/history Action reads, shares, citations, attachments and exports; exclude private execution fields. Thread/root/local and bounded parent projections must not include siblings or bypass grants. Automatic agent hydration, steering, busy/finalizing lifecycle and execution-private writer wiring move to .30 (PR B), .5 and .16.
Files: Channels ingress/CommunicationBridge/JidoChatBridge, Engine IncomingMessageRouter/Conversations/authorized read APIs, People/BO/artifact consumers. Reuse existing accounts.fetch_history read operation; no parallel persistence/recall Action. Tests FIRST: passive persistence before gating, denied/nil access, isolation/idempotency, per-message email audience and safe projection; real internal DB/domain paths, external transport/model mocks only. Include Channels/Engine/API documentation in A. One outcome PR, no bead-specific PR; new E2E waits .12.

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.

comments.text: Preparation from preceding PR A slices: EmailBridge now stamps :email kind from configured email:imap bridge/provider, not an Incoming metadata claim; JidoChatBridge only stamps evidenced Mattermost/Telegram/Discord kinds. The remaining ingress work is NOT solved: Jido.Chat nonmention on_new_message wildcard currently returns :ok without Engine dispatch; mention/path policy still routes to admit_incoming legacy messages; canonical transcript creation/association and Person-grant checks are not yet wired. Engine Conversations.append_canonical_message/3 requires an existing transcript and trusted source; Facts/Strategy currently pure and no create-or-resolve transcript API exists. Before changing capture, design transactional target creation + shared/thread parent + per-recipient ownership, dedup against legacy Message UUID/ratings/traces, and authorization/grant reconciliation; do not duplicate a mention in legacy and canonical messages or mistake kind evidence for a grant. Reuse existing Conversations/TranscriptHistory/Strategy APIs; no new Action exposed to agents. No feature E2E until .12 approval.

PR A capture foundation remains uncommitted and NOT ingress-wired. Action reuse assessment: reused Engine Conversations.append_canonical_message/3 + TranscriptHistory.append/3 and History.Facts/Strategy association_targets rather than a parallel writer/Action. Extended Conversations.capture_canonical_message/3 as Engine-local atomic target-resolver/orchestrator; not an agent-tool Action because it requires internally attested provider, connector, source account, actor and per-message recipient People, and would be unsafe to expose to agent arguments. Inputs Facts + message attrs + trusted source; returns placement IDs/positions or errors; SQL writes transactional; same external ID/source_scope replay idempotent; nil ID distinct; changed email recipient set denied under a per-identity transaction lock. Seed direct participant grants once when parent is created, not on replay/new child; shared remains provider-grant-only; Replicated owned by individual Person. Isolated capture/transcript tests pass (23 tests, 2 properties), mix q passes. Still needed: connector-scoped recipient resolution, passive nonmention ingress, legacy message-ID reuse/cutover preserving UUID/rating/attachment/trace, authorized BO/API shares/citations/export readers, membership synchronization and full PR A integration. Do not treat this foundation as a completed .4 or as proof of authorized caller provenance. No feature E2E authored.

Capture foundation follow-up: verified against existing StrategyTest that Direct thread replies reuse the one parent transcript (not a child), while Shared threads get a child; corrected the new integration test and documentation without weakening existing assertions. Added regression tests for missing Person, unscoped email UID, nil external ID (distinct placements), changed email recipient replay, simultaneous conflicting audience replays, transaction rollback, direct provider grant revocation vs manual grant. SQL transaction advisory lock serializes same replicated source identity before checking existing audience. Current broad isolated affected suite: 371 tests, 6 properties, 0 failures; mix q passes. Ingress, consumer cutover, and identity/grant wiring remain outstanding for PR A.

Recipient resolution action reuse recheck before wiring: People.match_by_channel/3 already performs scoped identity lookup by platform, identifier and connector; IdentityResolver.validate_connector/2 handles author connector but permits absent connector and is private. For passive email To/Cc, extend People.IdentityResolver with a read-only connector-validated resolver reusing People.match_by_channel("email", address, config_id); do not call find_or_create_from_channel or grant access from arbitrary header/metadata. Inputs: internally normalized per-message sender/visible-address evidence and resolved enabled email:imap connector; output only already-linked Person IDs, deduplicated, no unscoped/other-connector fallback; invalid connector/shape errors fail closed. No side effects, retry-safe; local-only helper is not an agent Action because it is an authorization-sensitive ingress implementation detail, not an independently invokable agent operation. Ingress must separately attest provenance before treating results as audience; tests should cover scoped match, missing/Bcc/unscoped identifiers, connector mismatch/disabled and bad inputs. Do not expose this resolver as a public authorization decision.

Read-only email-recipient Person lookup added in People.IdentityResolver.resolve_visible_email_recipients/2, reusing People.match_by_channel/3: requires matching enabled unarchived email:imap connector, matching sender evidence, visible_recipients list; returns only already-linked scoped Person IDs with dedup; no creation, grants, unscoped fallback or Bcc metadata lookup. It does not attest an arbitrary Incoming/Event nor persist associations, and has NO production call site yet. 17 IdentityResolver tests pass and mix q passes. Next wiring must ensure trusted adapter evidence and author resolution precede this lookup, and preserve per-message recipient snapshots.

Action reuse recheck for legacy UUID cutover: existing Conversations.admit_incoming/1 owns executable user-message identity/finalization and TranscriptHistory.canonical_message/3 owns canonical insertion/dedup. Extend the Engine-only capture writer to attach a caller-supplied, verified admitted user message UUID rather than inserting a second row when an agent already admitted the message. Validate source account/connector/provider/external ID and content against locked legacy row before setting its canonical source identity; preserve message UUID, conversation, metadata, ratings and trace. No agent Action: this is a privileged persistence seam, not a composable tool. Input is trusted binding from Engine admission, not arbitrary channel/BO supplied message ID; output same canonical placements or conflict; transaction must rollback on mismatch and replays be idempotent. Tests first using real admission and DB rating; do not wire ingress until no-agent-first then agent reroute also uses the same UUID.

Uncommitted legacy identity seam advanced (no ingress wiring yet). TranscriptHistory.capture/3 now accepts a trusted existing_message_id for an already-admitted user turn: locks Message, checks role/content/external ID plus scoped conversation provider/connector/channel, sets canonical source identity on the SAME UUID, and leaves conversation, metadata, rating and trace references intact; bad ID, body, connector or room rolls back target creation. For new IMAP admissions with unscoped legacy conversations, Conversations.admit_incoming/1 stores private history_source coordinates only if matching enabled IMAP connector, :email kind, normalized adapter sender, visible-recipient evidence and mailbox are present. Reuse compares the stamped mailbox/connector/channel; unstamped historical email rows still require non-destructive migration, not guessed scope. New unit/integration regressions cover rating+trace preservation, idempotency, mismatched binding and per-mailbox spoofing; affected suite 525 tests/6 properties passes and mix q passes. Still must solve no-agent-first then agent admission (reuse canonical row) plus race-safe cross-path admission before wiring passive capture; do not claim PR A complete or introduce duplicate legacy/canonical rows.

Action reuse recheck before no-agent-to-agent transition: extend existing Conversations.admit_incoming/1 (source-of-truth for execution binding and finalization token) to adopt an existing canonical Message only when its verified provider/connector/source-scope/external ID and transcript channel match the incoming adapter-stamped scope; do not introduce a second admission/Action or fabricate success. Return existing UUID with new token on first admission, nil token on replay; conflict on mismatched identity/content, retain canonical placements/rating/trace. Add DB tests first. Because capture/admission can race, do not wire either path until serialization covers both or rejects ambiguous overlaps.

No-agent-first to agent admission path now has Engine-only UUID adoption, still uncommitted and NOT enabled at ingress. Existing Conversations.admit_incoming/1 checks for a canonical source identity on trusted connector-stamped incoming before inserting a legacy row; locks the canonical message, verifies original content/author and a placement in the exact provider/connector/channel/strategy/thread, then links that SAME UUID to the conversation with a one-time finalization token. Redelivery returns nil token; mismatched room, strategy or sibling thread returns source_conflict rather than duplicating. Existing agent-first then capture(existing_message_id) also retains rating, trace and private metadata, including new IMAP private sender/mailbox stamp. Tests first: replay adoption and denied wrong channel/strategy/thread plus existing source-identity cases. `mix q` and affected tests passed. Cross-path simultaneous capture/admission still requires shared source-key serialization and admission-first canonical reuse before enabling passive ingress; never assume this sequential path resolves races.

PR A uncommitted Engine capture/admission seam advanced; no ingress wiring yet. Tests-first found and fixed wrong-author UUID reuse: newly admitted user messages retain provider author_id, and canonical capture requires exact author/content/external ID plus verified connector/room (and IMAP private mailbox coordinate); historical nil-author/unstamped rows deliberately fail closed pending non-destructive reconciliation. Scoped incoming admission and capture now share pg_advisory_xact_lock keyed by provider/connector/mailbox/external ID inside their respective transactions. Admission-first passive capture, passive-first admission, and simultaneous first writes reuse ONE message UUID; replay retains rating/trace/private metadata and never reissues a finalization token. Fixed canonical provider-ID replay into another room and conflicting author/content admission replay; canonical replay after adopting an external turn keeps the user role. Tests cover wrong room/connector/thread/strategy/mailbox/sender, race, UUID/replay/reference preservation and denial. Affected isolated suite 350 tests/6 properties passed; JidoChatBridge separately 182 tests passed; mix q passed; git diff --check clean. Remaining: trusted adapter provenance, connector-scoped Person association, passive nonmention ingress, provider membership revocation, consumer cutover, legacy migration and final approval gates. Do not enable ingestion without those; existing historical nil-author rows require explicit reconciliation. Action reuse: extended Conversations.admit_incoming/1 and TranscriptHistory.capture/3, private locking/query helpers local-only; no independent agent Action or tool exposure for privileged source binding.

Follow-up regression checks: canonical provider IDs can no longer be reused in a different room (while the existing parent-to-child append case remains supported), and replays after adopting an external message preserve its user role and UUID. Admission replays now reject changed author/content and changed IMAP mailbox source; legacy reuse accepts only external/user inputs with matching attested author, not assistant messages. Added explicit nil-author historical-row test: it refuses placement rather than guessing the sender, so legacy reconciliation remains required before rollout. 170 targeted tests/2 properties and mix q pass after final change; broader affected suite 350 tests/6 properties passed before the last nil-author regression; JidoChatBridge 182 tests passed separately. No migrations altered, no ingress wiring, no E2E authoring or Git/PR mutations.

PR A People-facing read reuse assessment before coding: PeopleConversations.dispatch/2 already authenticates confidential People bearer per operation and checks access_message_history; Conversations.list_canonical_messages/3 already checks Person plus transcript-path grant/owner and bounds projected content. Extend existing PeopleConversations with read-only :channel_history operation accepting transcript_id and bounded cursor, sourcing Person only from authenticated token, and delegate to Conversations.list_canonical_messages/3. No new Action/tool or parallel auth implementation; preserve existing legacy :detail/:message operation semantics; no channel-history shares/citations/exports until explicitly scoped. Tests first through existing Engine.Api :people_conversations confidential event with token and two People, check nil/unauthorized/revoked access, cursor, private metadata and trace exclusion. No UI changes.

title: [zaq-emb.4] PR A strategy-driven persistence, passive capture and authorized reads
